computers.intro: Each zone is one computer with its own logins. Bots in a zone share its computer.
computers.name: Name
computers.idleHint: The computer sleeps after this time without work.

sizeHint.small: 1 CPU, 1 GiB. Shell, files, Python and Node.
sizeHint.desktop: 2 CPU, 3 GiB. Adds screens you can take over.

networkHint.open: The computer can reach any site.
networkHint.allowlist: The computer can reach only the sites in the list.

computers.hostsHint: One host per line, for example docs.example.com.
computers.needHosts: Add at least one allowed site.
computers.badIdle: Give a number of minutes from 1 to 1440.
computers.noAllowlist: This provider cannot limit sites. Choose another provider, or allow all sites.
computers.saveFailed: Fettle did not save the change
computers.loadFailed: Fettle could not load the zones
computers.createDetail: A zone is a separate computer with its own logins.
computers.hostDetail: Bots then run commands on this computer with your user rights. Nothing isolates them.

modeHint.ask: Bots ask before each change outside the computer and each message they send.
modeHint.auto: Bots act without asking when the action clearly matches what you asked. Else they ask.
modeHint.never: Bots act without asking. Hard asks still need a card.

approvals.hardAsks: Some actions always need a card: new bots, zones and grants, the host provider and payments.
approvals.rulesIntro: A block rule wins over all other rules. An ask rule wins over an allow rule.
approvals.noRules: No rules yet. Always allow on a card adds one here.

valueHint.tool: For example browser_act. Use * for every tool.

approvals.needValue: Give a tool name or a pattern.

tokens.intro: Access tokens let the CLI and scripts use the API as you. Fettle shows a token one time only.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.copy: Copy the token now. Fettle does not show it again.
tokens.failed: Fettle could not change the tokens
tokens.localOnly: In local mode, the CLI uses the local token. Access tokens are for server mode.
